models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light northerlies easing to near-calm across the islands - but this is 6 days out, nothing here is a trip forecast.
briefing.synopsis: The current pattern over the Aeolians is a weak, slack northerly regime with no organised system in play: ECMWF IFS (27 Sep 00Z) and AIFS (27 Sep 06Z) agree on N-NNE at 6-10 kt today, strongest at Stromboli (9.8 kt, gusts 20.0 kt at midnight) and Panarea (9.2 kt), lighter at Portorosa (around 5 kt). Through 28-29 Sep the gradient collapses further - most islands drop to 1-4 kt with direction wandering between NW and E, and seas fall from about 2.0 ft to 0.1-0.4 ft. If that pattern held into the trip window it would mean motoring more than sailing, flat water and free choice of anchorage. The forecast only reaches 03 Oct, so the trip legs themselves are beyond any model in this payload.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight's berth is not yet a trip night - the only trip-window berth in range is Portorosa on 03 Oct, scored sheltered at 1.0 on 3.5 kt SSE, gusts 11.7 kt and 0.3 ft NNW swell. Portorosa Marina is the recommendation and the choice does not matter: it is enclosed with all-round shelter. Nothing in the payload would push the fleet to move.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Not applicable this far out - the fleet is still six days from departure. The first real decision point is the 04 Oct Portorosa to Lipari leg, which no model in this payload reaches. Expect the first genuine departure-window call about three days before you sail, when ICON-2i (2 km, ~60-72 h range) comes into play.

passage_notes.note: Dry run scored go, 5.0 kt broad reach, 06:00 start. Rehearsal only - not a forecast for 04 Oct.
Go at 1.9 kt, head to wind - a motor. Gusts to 6 kt are an interval-maximum in light air, not a caution.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Stromboli optional (rehearsal 30 Sep for 05 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go at 3.7 kt, head to wind - motoring passage in the rehearsal.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea optional (rehearsal 01 Oct for 06 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go at 5.1 kt on a run.
Go at 7.3 kt beam reach - the best sailing breeze in the rehearsal set.

cautions: Every leg verdict above is a rehearsal against this week's weather, not the trip dates. Treat them as a check on the analysis, not as guidance for 04-08 Oct.
Two hours at Portorosa show real model spread: 28 Sep 12:00 the models range 1.4-7.8 kt, and 29 Sep 06:00 they range 1.0-7.2 kt. Do not read the consensus mean as settled at those hours.

Stromboli's Marina del Gabbiano scored only workable (0.923) in the rehearsal - open from every direction, so its shelter depends entirely on it staying calm. Worth flagging early for the optional overnight.
Direction is the unstable element at long lead: mean direction shift at 72-120 h is 65 degrees, so the compass points above are far less reliable than the speeds.
briefing.confidence_note: Speeds have been stable run to run (mean wind shift under 1 kt at all lead times, max 4.7 kt), but the trip dates lie entirely beyond the 03 Oct forecast horizon and direction shifts average 65 degrees at 72-120 h.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
